Network Security

Zugriffsvektor-Filterung

A network defense technique that restricts or monitors traffic based on access vectors such as protocol, port, and direction, to minimize attack surface. See NIST SP 800-41r1.

Quick answer: A network defense technique that restricts or monitors traffic based on access vectors such as protocol, port, and direction, to minimize attack surface. See NIST SP 800-41r1.

Definition

A network defense technique that restricts or monitors traffic based on access vectors such as protocol, port, and direction, to minimize attack surface. See NIST SP 800-41r1.

Operational example

Implement access vector filtering to restrict inbound SSH and RDP traffic to only trusted management networks.
